{{Quote|They cover almost half of the residential annexes, six retail precincts, and the Bonchaka, Neldiz, and F'tu manufacturing districts.|[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], on Shield Securities|<ref name="CWGsi">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref>}}
The '''Bonchaka district''' was an area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was patrolled by [[Cam droid/Legends|cam droids]] supplied by [[Shield Securities]]. After [[Lok Durd]]'s sinister [[damotite bioweapon]] was unleashed on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] via Shield [[Security camera/Legends|security cameras]], the Bonchaka, [[Neldiz district|Neldiz]], and [[F'tu district|F'tu]] districts, as well as other parts of Coruscant, existed in fear of the [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] threat due to their security cams.<ref name="CWGsi" />
